title: Paths that skip RLS: table owner, BYPASSRLS, materialized views, late partitions, FK probes (correctness)
issue: Superusers and BYPASSRLS roles always skip RLS; owners skip it unless FORCE; materialized views cannot carry policies; a partition created after the policies were installed has none; FK checks run as owner.
symptom: Every query returns the number of rows the caller (acting as user1) can see through one path. Correct: only user1's rows. Counts above that are leaks. fk_existence_oracle counts hidden rows whose existence the caller could confirm (correct 0).

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.docs (10 orgs; user N is a member of org N only); app.docs_p holds the same rows for orgs 1..5 (6..10 go into a late partition)
